Palani Temple Land Registration Case: Probe Intensifies Amid Allegations

An investigation is underway into the alleged fraudulent registration of a ₹100-crore property belonging to the Arulmigu Dhandayuthapani Swamy Mutt in Palani, Tamil Nadu. The CB-CID has conducted raids at multiple locations as part of the probe. Questions have been raised about the awareness of the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments (HR&CE) Department regarding the registration.
